metadata.description: Local-first post-production automation for talking-head course video: rough cuts, dead-air removal, slides with a circular speaker cutout, and automatic slow zooms, delivered as one editable Premiere/Resolve timeline.

plugins.name: video-post
plugins.description: Post-production for talking-head video, run locally. Hand it raw footage and it asks for your brand font, colour and caption style, then cuts the dead air and fumbled takes, adds slow zooms, and captions it in your brand. You get a post-ready video plus an editable Premiere/Resolve timeline. Slides with a circular speaker cutout on request. Captions only, for an already-edited video, too.
